variants.title: Common emitter: a BC547A transistor
variants.unknown: the current gain of a BC547A
variants.note: The datasheet sorts BC547 by gain group: group A is 110 to 220. The middle of that group, 165, is the gain used here; a real BC547A can be anywhere inside the group, which is exactly why the gain has to be measured.

source.title: NXP BC546/BC547/BC548 datasheet: hFE group A = 110 to 220 at Ic = 2 mA, Vce = 5 V

variants.title: Common emitter: a BC547B transistor
variants.unknown: the current gain of a BC547B
variants.note: Group B of the BC547 is 200 to 450; the middle of that group, 325, is the gain used here.

source.title: NXP BC546/BC547/BC548 datasheet: hFE group B = 200 to 450 at Ic = 2 mA, Vce = 5 V

variants.title: Common emitter: a BC547C transistor
variants.unknown: the current gain of a BC547C
variants.note: Group C of the BC547 is 420 to 800; the middle of that group, 610, is the gain used here. Such a high gain means the base current must be kept very small.

source.title: NXP BC546/BC547/BC548 datasheet: hFE group C = 420 to 800 at Ic = 2 mA, Vce = 5 V
